claim: leg < 拉丁 lēx「法」/ legere「读、选」（两条语义支线）

records.name: Wiktionary
records.quote: from Latin legendus 'things which ought to be read', from lego 'to read'.

records.name: Wiktionary
records.quote: From Latin legibilis 'that can be read', from Latin legō.

note: lēx「法」与 legere「读」是同一词根的两条支线：legal 走 lēx，legend / legible 走 legere。词库 gloss 只写「法、委任」，未覆盖 legend 的「读」义。 词库外旁证条目（仅印证同一词源，不对应词库词条）：legible。
